user.title: Set up Comfort Pilot
user.description: Pick your split systems and where Comfort Pilot gets energy and weather data. Rooms, occupancy sensors and window sensors are detected from your areas automatically – you can adjust them afterwards under Configure.

data_description.grid_sensor: Positive when importing from the grid, negative when exporting solar.
data_description.solar_sensor: Not needed yet – recorded for future learning.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Used instead of the weather entity's temperature if set.
data_description.notify: Usually your phone, e.g. notify.mobile_app_yourphone. Leave empty to use Home Assistant notifications.

error.no_climates: Pick at least one split system.
error.no_outside: Pick a weather entity or an outdoor temperature sensor.

abort.already_configured: Comfort Pilot is already set up.

menu_options.sources: Split systems, energy, weather and notifications

room_edit.title: {room}
room_edit.description: The comfort band is the range Comfort Pilot works within. With solar to spare it goes to the comfortable end; on grid power it goes to the economy end.

data_description.window_sensors: Unit turns off if any is open for more than 2 minutes.
data_description.est_power: Used to share spare solar between rooms. Roughly what the unit draws once it's settled.
data_description.occupancy_delay: Motion must continue this long before the room counts as occupied, so walking through doesn't start the AC. 0 = straight away.
data_description.occupancy_timeout: Presence sensors use 5 minutes at most.

add_rule.title: Add a rule
add_rule.description: Example: all bedrooms, keep comfortable, every day, 21:00 to 06:30, 24°. Windows that end earlier than they start run past midnight.

data_description.target: Only for 'Keep comfortable'. Leave empty to let solar decide between the comfortable and economy ends.

data.cooling_season_above: Cooling season when today's forecast high is at least
data.heating_season_below: Heating season when today's forecast high is at most
data.solar_margin: Grid import tolerated before dropping comfort
data.precondition_hours: Pre-cool on spare solar this long before a rule
data.hot_day: Hot day (pre-cool 2 hours earlier) at forecast high of
data.start_margin: Start cooling once a room is this far above its setpoint (heating: below)
data.stop_margin: Stop cooling once a room is this far below its setpoint (heating: above)
data.fresh_air_delta: Fresh air alert when outside is cooler by
data.fresh_air_min_indoor: Only send fresh air alerts when inside is at least
data.min_run_minutes: Once on, keep a unit running for at least
data.min_off_minutes: Once off, keep a unit off for at least

error.no_climates: Pick at least one split system.
error.no_outside: Pick a weather entity or an outdoor temperature sensor.
error.band_order: The first value must be lower than the second.
error.same_time: Start and end can't be the same.

abort.no_rules: There are no rules to remove.
